compression.experimental_caveat: Combined codec and bounded CountSketch changes are not a single-factor performance experiment.
compression.scope: Fixed-schema encoded outgoing application artifacts. Excludes initial dense formation, final model downloads, wire envelopes, TLS, acknowledgements and retransmissions. Not an 80.3024% reduction in full network traffic.

compressed_full_size_execution.historical_disposition: Functional and accounting result passed; memory readiness failed and final consensus delivery was incomplete. No promotion to longer training was justified by this run alone.

memory_gate.scope: Frozen engineering resource criteria, not a grant requirement. Three rounds cannot establish long-run stability.

shutdown_delivery.scope: Passing event/metric delivery counters did not imply final consensus-sketch drain; the adverse consensus drops remain.

compressed_full_size_execution.timing_scope: Instrumented whole-run observation including preparation, dense formation, warmup, finalization and parallel collection; not a causal speedup or steady-state throughput claim.

derivation: Selected scientific facts transcribed from three retained sanitized historical reports. This file is a derived review summary, not raw model, runtime, memory-trace or accounting proof. No experiment or test was rerun for this file.

identity_g2_execution.checkpoint_pruning: Exactly one current checkpoint remained after confirmation across three rounds; this establishes disk pruning, not memory reclamation.
identity_g2_execution.memory_limitation: Completed short H12 execution had substantial host RAM/swap pressure. It did not establish sustained-memory readiness.

original_rank0_audit_admission.status: unmet; original rank0 audit was not dispatched

identity_g2_execution.timing_scope: Formation, preparation, warmup, node work, export and authorized parallel collection; not steady GPU or pure-network throughput.

later_memory_and_shutdown_repair.checkpoint_ownership_repair: Removed recursive serializer helper ownership cycles without forced GC or checkpoint format changes.
later_memory_and_shutdown_repair.memory_causality_limit: Removing checkpoint ownership cycles does not explain every cause of the earlier private-network RAM growth.
later_memory_and_shutdown_repair.private_end_to_end_qualification: Requires separate measured private-AXL evidence; these public diagnostics do not certify it by themselves. Later completed private runs are documented separately.

public_cpu_diagnostic.end_only_gc_and_allocator_trim: Separate labeled diagnostics, not inserted into baseline production training.
public_cpu_diagnostic.interpretation: Serializer fix removed retained snapshots but did not reduce end-of-run USS in the default CPU fixture. Static mmap threshold reduced final post-round USS by 54.03% versus fixed default, with 27.26% slower instrumented execution; not a library default.

public_gpu_copy_path_diagnostic.scope: Matched public GPU-copy/persistence seam, not GPT computation, private gradient training, full network workload, general speedup or language quality.

shutdown_repair.scope: Actual real-AXL completion regression; not a full private GPT learning experiment.

preserved_limits: No evaluation loss, perplexity or language quality measured in the short full-size resource executions.
Original memory-gate failure and final-sketch drops are retained; passing model/accounting checks do not erase them.
Public CPU and GPU diagnostics isolate different seams; their absolute memory/timing values are not a one-factor hardware comparison.
These sources report historical scoped cleanup; they do not imply that all later retained project hosts are closed.
Raw scientific bodies, private owner history, model/checkpoint bytes and full traces are intentionally excluded.
scope: Additional language-model execution/resource studies; they do not replace original M3 acceptance evidence or independently establish language quality.
